content: Next, the DU-level Bi-LSTM will process the sequence of discourse unit embeddings in a paragraph and generate two hidden states $\overrightarrow{hDU_t}$ and $\overleftarrow{hDU_t}$ at each discourse unit position. We concatenate them to get the discourse unit representation $hDU_t = [\overrightarrow{hDU_t}, \overleftarrow{hDU_t}]$ .
